text_block_list.text:
Shopping one day, spotted lively trio once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hair ties, hair ties~♪ Stylish, cute, 
stretchy hair ties~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hope there are lots of cute hair ties♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Feature article: 'Hairstyling starts with 
hair ties!' huh? Fashion really is hard 
work~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Riding trends makes adult woman, right♪ 
Totally!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Hey. Didn't we have this exact 
conversation before?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We did~. Was it pin badges last time?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Current trend is hair ties now! No point 
looking back~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No point, no point~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But we said we'd get matching ones. What 
happened to that in the end~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ummm~... we searched for badges here, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't really much variety in stock, 
you see~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Plus it's close to school, so everyone 
would've had matching ones!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, we headed to the trendy adult district 
at the very cutting edge of fashion!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And there were crowds of sparkly, shiny, 
mature women everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Looking at price tags, shop after shop had 
an extra zero at the end!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, we couldn't buy anything 
and felt super bummed out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since we were there, though, we ate trendy 
sweets before heading back~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I remember~ Those sweets were so 
yummy. I should try making them sometime~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Bono-chan! Today's about fashion, not 
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today we're definitely gonna get our hands 
on those super trendy hair ties~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ufufu♪ Good luck, Maya-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're coming too, Bono-chan! Right, 
Curren Chan?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, yep♪ Let's all become super 
fashionable together~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! The three of us are gonna 
sprint straight to the top of trends~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yeah~♪

Mayano Top Gun's refusal to fall behind 
the latest trends might carry over into 
her running... or maybe not.
